how: We read the website of every Minneapolis wedding photographer listed on Lazo (104 listings, 88 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: an Eau Claire photographer with a Stillwater pin, brand and headshot studios, a photo booth company, portrait-first studios, and a national multi-service chain. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Have you shot a winter wedding here, and how do you handle a 4:30 sunset and portraits in the snow?
What is the delivery timeline, and is a second shooter included or an add-on?
Can I see one full wedding gallery from a venue like mine, not a highlight reel?

picks.name: Jeannine Marie Photography
picks.blurb: Jeannine has photographed over 1,000 weddings and engagement sessions since 2007, across Christian, Hindu, Buddhist, Jewish and Greek Orthodox ceremonies as well as LGBTQ+ celebrations. St. Paul based, documentary storytelling with portrait artistry, and she backs up every card twice before she goes home.

picks.name: Heidi Straus Photography
picks.blurb: Based near Lake Minnetonka in Minnetrista/St. Bonifacius, Heidi shoots candid, true-to-life weddings around Wayzata, Orono and Minneapolis. Her pricing page says most couples invest $5,000 to $7,000 for full-day coverage, and she is booking 2026 and 2027.

picks.name: J.Olson Weddings
picks.blurb: J.Olson works in a modern journalistic style from a studio in Minneapolis and travels worldwide. Midwest wedding coverage begins at $4,900, Monday-to-Thursday Minnesota elopements at $2,100, and discounts are offered to working artists, designers, musicians and healthcare workers.

picks.name: Hiropix Studios
picks.blurb: Kenny 'Hiro' Fukuda left a career as a corporate litigator after working a wedding, and Hiropix now fields a full team of photographers in Minneapolis/St. Paul, San Francisco and New York. Collections start at $5,200 and the pitch is moments over poses.

picks.name: DnK Photography
picks.blurb: Dan and Karin Berdal have photographed nearly 300 weddings and over 1,200 other sessions since 2008 as a husband-and-wife duo out of New Hope. They divide up getting-ready coverage, deliver wedding images in four weeks or less, and take 10 percent off Friday, Sunday and winter weddings.

picks.name: RKH Images
picks.blurb: Kyle and Tracy Hansen are a Burnsville husband-and-wife team working worldwide since 2010. Kyle's background is concert photography and he keeps images true to life and clear of trends; the site calls them total nerds who focus on fun, and pricing is linked from the site.

picks.name: Eileen K. Photography
picks.blurb: Eileen K Photography was born in 2010 in South Minneapolis, and every package includes Eileen plus an assistant photographer and a USB gift box. Natural, relaxed and fun is the promise, with elopement and micro-wedding packages that can add ceremony video.

picks.name: Charnell Timms Photography
picks.blurb: Charnell has shot professionally since 2009 and moved from South Africa to Maple Grove in 2019. Her 'Passionately Playful' style is energetic and vibrant, packages are design-your-own by hours plus prints, and she has been commissioned for destination weddings in France, England, Germany, Mexico and Ireland.

picks.name: Ryan A Stadler Photography
picks.blurb: Ryan shoots Polaroids, 35mm, medium format and large format film alongside digital, and has been a freelance photographer since 2010. Minneapolis based with North Shore and Lake Superior work, an observer by nature who keeps things low key; his oldest daughter started helping at weddings in 2025.

picks.name: Clewell Photography
picks.blurb: Jes began photographing weddings in 2005 and blends editorial, traditional and documentary approaches with a taste for dramatic light and striking architecture. Serves the Twin Cities and frequently shoots in Milwaukee, Chicago and LA; the site promises Grandma will love the photos and your friends will be jealous.

picks.name: Erin Johnson Photography
picks.blurb: Erin Johnson has photographed over 400 weddings in 17 years and limits herself to 30 a year. Minneapolis based, wedding day coverage begins at $3,300 and includes rights to the edited high-resolution images, with associate photographers listed on the site.

picks.name: Anna Ko Photography
picks.blurb: Anna photographs love as it happens, messy laughter and wind-blown hair included, in a modern editorial style for minimalist couples who would rather not be pulled away for posing. Based in Wayzata, she takes a limited number of weddings each year and helps with timelines and family dynamics.
